title: Kicked Peppery Dutch Piccalilli Gratin
description: A vegan-friendly, peppery Dutch dish featuring piccalilli, perfect for a sick day, made with flambe and served in individual mini cocottes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small saucepan, flambe the piccalilli over medium heat for 2 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vegan cream, black pepper, cayenne pepper, smoked paprika, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the cream mixture to the flambeed piccalilli and stir to combine.
Divide the piccalilli mixture among 4 individual mini cocottes.
Sprinkle the bread crumbs and salt over the top of each cocotte.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
